depiction.primary_object: four vertical rectangular bars arranged as a waterfall chart
depiction.composition: three short bars stepping diagonally upward left-to-right beside one full-height bar on the right

readings.meaning: cumulative progress / step-by-step growth toward a total

ambiguity: Easily mistaken for generic bar chart or signal strength bars at small sizes if the floating middle bars are not noticed.
